title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the West, North, and South-east regions of Guatemala, contributes to outcome 1.1 Duty-bearers have taken actions to respect and protect rights. The objective is that at-risk women and men and their defenders, especially women and women access to justice defenders, have increased access to holistic protection measures / mechanisms. Activities include capacity building of access to justice defenders; and provision of psychosocial and other supports to access to justice defenders. The programme is in partnership with 8 local partners. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Advocacy for the protection of human rights- Protection and support for human rights defenders, especially women
